Half-minus-full is +0.0001204973 AUC aligned and+0.0004667050 crossed; interaction crossed-minus-aligned is +0.0003462077 at seed 42. Conditional one-seed controlled support, not repeated robustness or semantic mediation.
Aligned half improves15/23 slice AUCs and16/23 losses, with short/empty-history regressions. Crossed half improves20/23 AUCs and23/23 losses. Uniform slice superiority is contradicted.

Aligned half is the preferred operational anchor; retain the unreproduced historical magnitude maximum, exact17 failed replay, round26 positive and round27 negative. No frozen final selection or host-incumbent change.

plan.question: Does the existing aligned global-half backward scale allocation improve validation ROC-AUC over aligned native-full normalization across prospectively paired initializations, and does the accumulated model improve over the original local target-aware reference? The latest matched seed42 control has AUC 0.6151021885074872 and Logloss 0.19653258393542125; the <=16-event native-full fallback has AUC 0.6149512044560076 and Logloss 0.1967260436303771. Its small 1-16-event improvement accompanies worse empty-history ranking and population performance, so the earlier slice deficit is not established as a locally repairable derivative defect. Repeated seed42 replays do not resolve initialization sensitivity or adaptive validation selection. Prioritize retrieval needed to freeze and fund baseline/full/half paired comparisons at authorized seeds43/44, retaining seed42 only with verified matching identities, before considering further cutoff or architecture search. Shared-parameter coupling, generic conditioning and checkpoint selection remain alternative explanations; repetitions test robustness, not unique mechanism mediation or novelty.
missing_information: An explicitly authorized paired-seed execution interface for43/44 and its admission rules. The current frozen train_seed is42; this query phase authorizes only retrieval-plan.json. Do not simulate new seeds inside candidate code, train locally or alter the frozen protocol.

Exported executable source/configuration/checkpoint identities for the original local target-aware baseline and matched aligned full/half controls. Verify inherited parameter construction, donor and tangent rules, masks/floor guards, scalar loss, optimizer, initialization/data order and checkpoint policy before execution or seed42 checkpoint reuse. Half denotes rank-based donor-scale reassignment, not multiplying the whole gradient by0.5; row_intervention=none does not remove that reassignment.

Complete costs and refreshed ledger for preparation, failures, all admitted paired jobs, attribution, analysis and final closed assessment. The resolved budget snapshot is26604.183530569077 seconds; six new jobs for three arms at two seeds cost up to10565.594594406364 seconds at the declared per-trial cap before assessment and other reserves. This arithmetic does not establish affordability. Admit only complete prespecified blocks with funded reserves, independent of favorable outcomes.

Prospective selection, uncertainty and stopping rules for a fixed comparison suite. Report every seed's signed half-minus-full and accumulated-model-minus-baseline AUC, secondary unweighted Logloss and measured costs; disclose adaptive seed42 selection. Mixed/nonpositive effects weaken robustness. Freeze source/config/checkpoint hashes, selected arms, closest controls, seeds and real commands before one closed assessment; withheld outcomes must remain outside open research memory and must not trigger reselection.

Authorized per-example validation predictions and user-cluster identities for paired cluster uncertainty, and training-defined slice counts if available. Aggregate metrics alone cannot supply confidence intervals. Empty, short and long-history findings remain exploratory; AUC cannot be additively decomposed across slices. Current candidate-owned checks cover only512 ordered validation inputs, including10 short and4 empty rows, and do not establish training-wide correctness or shared-update mediation.

Archived paper:din version content-sha256:5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2, lines240-299, supports inherited target-aware activation and explicitly omits activation softmax; the local masked-softmax/product/backward adaptations are not an exact DIN reproduction.
